teaser: The meter, the credit, Stripe top-ups and the account in your own vault run today; checking payments is what is proposed.
core_idea: The reader's account on this site is built and in daily use, the meter, starting credit, Stripe top-ups and an account kept in the reader's own vault across devices with a lane any browser can write to, while the server sees only ciphertext; what remains proposed is checking each payment against Stripe and signing the result, and a missing status page let an agent mistake one for the other.

nodes.label: The meter
nodes.summary: Charges by how much was read.

quotes.text: it does not, and cannot, verify the payment
For something with no server keeping the balance, it is quite powerful

figures.caption: The reading account, piece by piece: the meter, £5 of starting credit, top-up with Stripe, the account in your vault, a balance across devices, devices merged, notes and send to my vault, and a server that sees only ciphertext, all built; checking payments against Stripe, signed validations and one account across our sites, proposed.
